title: Two loci, one test cross
instructions: Predict before sampling. Use the phased chromosomes to explain each answer. The synthetic sample is one reproducible trial, not a guaranteed ratio.
prompts: List Parent 1’s four gametes, their probabilities and parental/recombinant marker classes. What gamete does the tester produce?
Predict offspring genotype and phenotype probabilities. Compare the sample counts with your expectations.
Compare AB/ab with Ab/aB at r = 0%, 10% and 50%. When does phase change gamete probabilities?
adaptationNotes: Adapt this one example by changing phase, r or sample settings; hold other controls fixed. Model r is 0–50 whole percentages. Use 1–1,000 offspring and integer seeds 0–4294967295. A finite observed recombinant proportion can exceed 50%; no map-distance or rate inference is performed.
